anya: kicking off a regional quant sweep for Cedar-13B across h100 us-west, a100 eu-west, h100 apac. profiles: fp16, bf16, int8, fp8-e4m3. quick notes first pass

sasha: nice — what input seq and batch sizes?

anya: seq=1024, bs=1 and bs=8 for throughput points. perf harness: `rbench --model cedar-13b --seq 1024 --bs {1,8} --q {fp16,bf16,int8,fp8-e4m3} --gpu {h100,a100}`

matt: can you paste p50/p95 and tokens/s? also include any kernel toggles you tried (fused attention, chunked matmuls)

anya: pasted raw table below (p50/p95 in ms, tok/s for bs=8, quality measured as avg exact-match on eval-set):

```
GPU      | q-profile | p50(ms) | p95(ms) | tok/s (bs8) | EM_delta
h100-us  | fp16      | 48      | 82      | 22.3k       | 0.0%
h100-us  | bf16      | 49      | 84      | 21.9k       | 0.0%
h100-us  | fp8-e4m3  | 30      | 55      | 33.0k       | -0.3%
h100-us  | int8      | 18      | 40      | 62.0k       | -0.6%

a100-eu  | fp16      | 62      | 110     | 18.5k       | 0.0%
a100-eu  | bf16      | 63      | 112     | 17.9k       | 0.0%
a100-eu  | fp8-e4m3  | 41      | 78      | 26.8k       | -0.7%
a100-eu  | int8      | 34      | 68      | 30.1k       | -1.4%

h100-apac | fp16     | 52      | 90      | 20.8k       | 0.0%
h100-apac | fp8-e4m3 | 33      | 60      | 31.2k       | -0.4%
h100-apac | int8     | 20      | 45      | 58.5k       | -0.9%
```

anya: kernel toggles: int8 uses `fused_gemm_q8` w/ channel-wise scale heuristic and `kv_shard=false` for single-GPU; fp8 used `fp8_kern_v2` + mixed-accum. fp8 stability: needed quant-warmup (200 steps) to reach stable EM numbers

jordan: interesting — int8 on H100 is huge perf win but quality regressions larger on A100. any idea why int8 worse on a100?

anya: hypothesis: A100 kernel fallback to generic path for some matmul shapes, and scale calibration less stable with current per-tensor scheme. logs show more `quant_fallback` events on a100 run.

matt: data point: we measured memory bandwidth utilization higher on h100 int8 path, implies custom kernels are effectively vectorized. can we capture nvprof traces?

anya: yes, uploaded perf traces to s3://redwood-perf/cedar13b/1738450123/ — nvtx markers: QUANT_START / KERNEL_GEMM_Q8 / ATT_NORM_FUSED

perf-bot: summary: Cedar-13B regional quant sweep (seq=1024). Best throughput: H100 int8 (62k tok/s, -0.6% EM). Recommended safe profile for rollout: fp8-e4m3 on H100 (33k tok/s, -0.3% EM) and fp16/bf16 on A100 for now (int8 shows >1% EM drop).

jordan: agreed. @anya, can you produce canary config for Dedicated pool: use `h100-quant-canary` with fp8 first, int8 disabled on eu-west until we investigate further. Target p95 SLA 100ms.

anya: will do. plan: create canary with 2 replicas, xtra logging (kv seeds + EM sampled), enable rollback if EM_drop > 0.8% over 1k requests. patch coming in ~2h :thumbsup:

sasha: thanks, this is great — can you also add a short note for docs about quant-warmup requirement for fp8 so solutions eng is aware?

anya: yup adding to onboarding guide under "quant profiles". linking to perf traces in the note.

matt: one more ask — run int8 with per-channel scales on a100 as an experiment, might close the EM gap.

anya: added to queue; will run overnight and post results tomorrow morning.
